lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in an irregular grid of approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with inter-blob distance roughly uniform along the horizontal axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity reflectance on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance objects (commensal remoras) attached to the ventral surface and near the posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin.
